The [[Lant]] system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].
